name: TfL Train Pack
description:
This pack contains various material for the London area. You will find:
Deep Tube Stock (1992/1995/2009/2024), Surface-Level Tube (S-Stock)
DLR (B07/B24), Trams (CR 4000/Variobahn)
Trains all the tracks (Aventra, Electrostar, Networker, Desiro UK, FLIRT UK, AT300, Pendolino, Javelin and Aurora)
